description: Attributable external cheat-code reports, distinct from source text hints and independently observed gameplay. Historical Game Genie listings can republish earlier code tables; no report here implies emulator verification.

claims.assessment_note: A GameFAQs-hosted historical FAQ reproduces Lewis Galoob's Game Genie notes. The exact 1DCC-CA7A code is labeled almost invincible, with a warning to disable it if stuck. It is presented as one of two version-dependent alternatives; no cartridge hash or actual test is documented.

claims.assessment_note: A GameFAQs-hosted historical FAQ reproduces Lewis Galoob's code updates and reports C2C1-4A9C as the alternate-version code for infinite lives, versus C2C9-4E2C on another build. The imported source filename's USA region is only a hint; neither exact revision nor execution was tested.

evidence.reference: Q-11: Game Genie, Lives, C2C9-4E2C alternate C2C1-4A9C
